title: Make a Smaller Video Copy Before AirDrop
description: Make a smaller copy of a large iPhone video before AirDrop. Check the exported file size and playback, then share the copy and keep the original.
direct: Compress a separate viewing copy first, then AirDrop that file. Keep the original for editing or delivery when the recipient needs full quality.
figureAlt: Two phones near each other beside a card showing a single video frame
figureCaption: AI-generated illustration. The scene illustrates transferring a chosen viewing copy between nearby devices.
cards.decision.heading: Decide which copy the recipient needs
cards.decision.body: The copy you send should match the task. A smaller preview can be enough for a quick review. A project handoff may need the original resolution, frame rate and detail.
sections.detail-1.heading: Use file size to check the result
sections.detail-1.body: A different filename or container does not say how much data the file contains. Read the saved copy’s size. If the clip is still too large for your purpose, try a smaller quality preset on a fresh copy from the original.
sections.detail-2.heading: Check the connection separately
sections.detail-2.body: Keep the devices near each other and confirm the recipient can receive via AirDrop. If a small known-good file also fails, troubleshoot discovery or use a cable for the original. Compression does not change AirDrop settings.
faqs.reader-1.heading: Is there a universal size to aim for?
faqs.reader-1.body: Choose a size that suits the recipient’s use and the detail they need. Compare the actual files.
faqs.reader-2.heading: Should I compress a video for an editor?
faqs.reader-2.body: Ask the editor which source properties they need. Keep the original available.

steps.step-1.text: Open the video in Phone Cleaner: Photo & Video and choose a smaller output preset. Keep the original in Photos.
steps.step-2.text: Save the export and compare the file sizes. Check sharpness, motion and sound, especially where the video contains small writing or fast movement.
steps.step-3.text: Share that specific export by AirDrop. Ask the recipient to open it and confirm it is the expected clip before you remove any files.
